ios.desc:
See your music take shape around you. Chromatic Resonance turns rhythm, dynamics, and musical accents into three spatial worlds for Apple Vision Pro.

THREE WAYS TO FEEL THE MUSIC
• Pyrotechnic Sky: luminous fireworks with glowing trails, unfolding in three distinct programs.
• Hurricane: layered clouds, sweeping rain, and distant lightning surrounding a quiet eye.
• Aether: thousands of fine filaments flowing through a living current of light.

YOUR MUSIC, MORE WAYS
Start with the included music, import an MP3 from Files, or browse free music to download. Choose Microphone to let the visuals follow music playing in the room. On visionOS 27 or later, Screen Audio lets you visualize audio from an app or browser you choose to share. Source availability and content restrictions apply.

BESIDE YOU OR AROUND YOU
Keep a floating visualization beside your controls, or enter an immersive world with local music. Add a night sky, choose a color palette, adjust intensity, and create a new arrangement. Music and visual controls have their own clear space. Screen Audio uses the floating visualization.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Playback and audio analysis happen on your device. Captured audio is never saved or uploaded. No account is required. Free-music searches contact Openverse only when you choose to search, and downloads come from the selected provider.
